title: Archive and Terminal
author: I. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Rafael Joubert, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
